driftwood.tools:
# Build tools only; never applied to a cluster or inherited as policy.
# ADR-0025 delegated: compiler updates must not silently accept a policy major.
# GitRepository shape reuses the existing tag/SHA readers; this file is outside GitOps.
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: platform-tools
spec:
  url: https://github.com/policy-as-versioned-platform/platform
  ref:
    tag: v4.0.0
    commit: 557c1538fe022c784ea4ffb345c92d2e4b11fe71
driftwood.gotk:
# Canonical Flux sync for driftwood — the provenance base everything stacks on.
#
# Pinned to a TAG + COMMIT, not a moving branch: git is the only way cluster
# state changes, and the exact revision is immutable + attestable. The tag is
# gitsign-signed (keyless → Rekor); that signature is verified out-of-band by
# `git verify-tag` / Rekor lookup in the provenance beat (ticket 24) — Flux's
# GitRepository.spec.verify only speaks OpenPGP, so we do NOT fake a PGP block
# here; the pin + the signed tag are the provenance, not a mis-typed verify.
#
# For the offline touring demo, scripts/up.sh rewrites .spec.url to the
# in-cluster git server and sets the freshly-seeded tag+commit (see up.sh).
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: driftwood
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1m
  url: https://github.com/policy-as-versioned-driftwood/driftwood
  ref:
    tag: v1.0.0
    commit: 92034b0927eb0c15aa9760deddbe6da2960038f0
    # commit pinned at release (belt-and-braces immutability, ADR-0001) --
    # the resolved SHA driftwood's own v1.0.0 tag points to. Not covered by the
    # Renovate customManagers in renovate.json (those track nist and platform
    # only); a self-pin bump is a reviewed PR that moves both fields together.
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: driftwood
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m
  retryInterval: 1m
  timeout: 3m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: driftwood
  # ./gitops/apps, NOT ./apps (eco-system ticket 33 review, 2026-09-08 -- the fix tuppence and
  # ludlow took under ticket 42 and driftwood never did). This object's source is the github.com
  # remote above, whose tree root holds gitops/, so ./apps resolves to nothing there and the
  # Kustomization never becomes Ready: driftwood's own drift-sample lane, run 34122734820,
  # reported exactly that (`kustomization path not found: stat .../apps`). ./apps was right only
  # in the OFFLINE SEED world: scripts/up.sh seeds a throwaway repo from the gitops/ directory
  # itself, so gitops/ IS that repo's root -- and up.sh applies its own inline Kustomization with
  # ./apps for exactly that reason, so this line does not touch the touring demo.
  path: ./gitops/apps
  prune: true   # prune-on-retire: remove what git no longer declares
  wait: true    # health-gate the reconcile
